It lowered interest rates to support the Nasdaq.
It purchased long-dated government securities.
It introduced a stablecoin settlement pilot.
questions.e: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time since 2023, which coincided with the Nasdaq climbing on September 17, 2026. The other options describe actions taken by other central banks or entities, not this specific Federal Reserve decision.

questions.q: What decision did the Bank of England make regarding its benchmark interest rate?
o: It maintained the rate at 3.75% after a 6-3 split vote.
It raised the rate to 4.00% to combat energy inflation.
It lowered the rate to 3.1% in response to August data.
It suspended all benchmark rate decisions indefinitely.
questions.e: The Bank of England maintained its benchmark rate at 3.75% following a 6-3 split vote among policymakers. Inflation reached 3.1% in August 2026, but the rate itself was held steady rather than changed to match that figure.

questions.q: How did the Bank of England alter its Asset Purchase Facility strategy?
o: It halted sales of long-dated gilts as part of its quantitative easing unwind adjustments.
It increased the benchmark interest rate to offset government borrowing.
It purchased an additional £50,000 crore of sovereign debt.
It eliminated all quantitative tightening measures permanently.
questions.e: The Bank of England halted sales of long-dated gilts as part of its updated quantitative easing unwind plan detailed in letters exchanged with HM Treasury. The other options either misstate the tool used or mix in figures from other central banks like the Reserve Bank of India.

questions.q: What movement did the DAX register following the US central bank rate decision?
o: It opened 0.77% higher and reached an over one-week high.
It plunged sharply alongside Bilfinger shares during the session.
It remained flat as investors digested German inflation data.
It dropped by 2.9% due to rising energy costs.
questions.e: The DAX opened 0.77% higher and reached an over one-week high following the US central bank rate decision. While Bilfinger shares plunged during the session, the overall index registered a gain rather than a drop.

questions.q: What primarily drove the acceleration of German inflation to 2.9%?

A technical rebound in Hochtief stock prices.
The Federal Reserve raising interest rates.
A reverse 1-for-3 stock split by regional firms.
questions.e: German inflation accelerated to 2.9% because rising energy prices drove the headline consumer price increase. Stock movements and US central bank decisions do not directly drive German consumer price indices.

questions.q: Why did the Bank of Japan's rate hike to 1.25% fail to support the Japanese yen?

Orix JREIT secured 10.6 billion yen in new credit facilities instead.
Kyobo Life Insurance bypassed the US dollar intermediary.
Domestic inflation fell below baseline expectations.
questions.e: Hawkish Federal Reserve adjustments and broader carry trades undermined the efficacy of the Bank of Japan's rate hike on the yen. Corporate refinancing and stablecoin pilots are separate financial activities that do not dictate currency valuation responses.

questions.q: What was the purpose of the pilot completed by Kyobo Life Insurance and SBI?

To secure new credit facilities for Orix JREIT debt obligations.
To refinance maturing government bonds through the Bank of Japan.
To increase domestic interest rates above 1.25%.
questions.e: Kyobo Life Insurance and SBI completed a pilot for direct yen-won stablecoin exchanges to bypass the US dollar intermediary. This modifies cross-border settlement mechanics rather than addressing Orix JREIT credit facilities or central bank rates.

Equities closed flat because the Reserve Bank of India cut borrowing costs.
questions.e: Indian stock benchmarks traded sideways with the Nifty closing above 23,250, while the rupee dropped below 96 before recovering to settle 3 paise lower at 95.94. The other options invent large market rallies or incorrect central bank rate actions.

questions.e: The Central Bank of Brazil lowered the Selic rate to 13.75% in its fifth consecutive reduction. Petrobras adjusted diesel prices and subsidies, but the central bank itself executed an easing move rather than a rate hike or rate freeze.

It cancelled multi-year simulation software agreements with Computer Modelling Group.

questions.e: Petrobras increased average diesel prices by 1 real per litre while simultaneously granting a discount in the exact same amount under a new diesel subsidy program. Software agreements and deepwater contracts are separate operational arrangements.

questions.e: Benchmark oil prices surged above $105 per barrel following supply restrictions, including halted supplies to Indian refiners and cancelled European cargoes due to infrastructure impacts and attacks. Software tools and digital value reports do not directly drive global oil price surges.
